preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression:
all(line.strip() == '' for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() == '' and line != stdin.split('
')[0])
preconditions.description: Each test case is preceded by an empty line, except the first line.

preconditions.expression:
all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' '))
preconditions.description: Each edge line contains exactly two integers a_i and b_i (1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n) representing the start and end of an edge.

preconditions.expression:
all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' ') for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: For each edge, a_i and b_i are integers between 1 and n (inclusive).

preconditions.expression:
all(len(set((int(a), int(b)) for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' '))) == len([line for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' ')]))
preconditions.description: The graph has no multi-edges, meaning each ordered pair (a_i, b_i) appears at most once.

preconditions.expression:
all(1 <= n <= 4 * 10**5 and 0 <= m <= 4 * 10**5 for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() and not line.startswith(' ') and line.split()[0] != 't')
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (number of vertices) and m (number of edges) satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ 4 * 10^5 and 0 ≤ m ≤ 4 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression:
all(len(output_line.split()) == n for output_line in stdout.split('
') if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly n integers, one for each vertex from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression:
all(int(x) in {0, 1, 2, -1} for output_line in stdout.split('
') if output_line.strip() for x in output_line.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer for a vertex is one of {0, 1, 2, -1}, representing the number of paths from vertex 1 to that vertex.

postconditions.expression:
all((int(stdout.split('
')[i].split()[j]) == 1) == (len(paths_from_1_to_v) == 1) for i in range(0, len(stdout.split('
')), 2) for j in range(n) for v in range(1, n+1) if j == v-1)
postconditions.description: For each vertex v, output 1 if and only if there is exactly one path from vertex 1 to v (including the empty path for v=1).

postconditions.expression:
all((int(stdout.split('
')[i].split()[j]) == 0) == (len(paths_from_1_to_v) == 0) for i in range(0, len(stdout.split('
')), 2) for j in range(n) for v in range(1, n+1) if j == v-1)
postconditions.description: For each vertex v, output 0 if and only if there are no paths from vertex 1 to v.

postconditions.expression:
all((int(stdout.split('
')[i].split()[j]) == 2) == (len(paths_from_1_to_v) > 1 and len(paths_from_1_to_v) != float('inf')) for i in range(0, len(stdout.split('
')), 2) for j in range(n) for v in range(1, n+1) if j == v-1)
postconditions.description: For each vertex v, output 2 if and only if there are more than one finite path from vertex 1 to v.

postconditions.expression:
all((int(stdout.split('
')[i].split()[j]) == -1) == (len(paths_from_1_to_v) == float('inf')) for i in range(0, len(stdout.split('
')), 2) for j in range(n) for v in range(1, n+1) if j == v-1)
postconditions.description: For each vertex v, output -1 if and only if there are infinitely many paths from vertex 1 to v.

postconditions.expression:
all(len(stdout.split('
')) == t + 1 and all(line.strip() == '' for line in stdout.split('
')[1::2]) for t in [int(stdin.split()[0])])
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines of results, one for each test case, with empty lines separating them in the input but not in the output.
